      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create, the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the
            '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server sets it to its current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-only flag. When true, the owner is allowed to be created even
            though another owner already has the same last name and address (for

          default: false

          example: false

              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:

          format: int32

          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create, the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the
            '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server sets it to its current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-only flag. When true, the owner is allowed to be created even
            though another owner already has the same last name and address (for
            example, family members living together). Defaults to false.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where
                LAST3 is the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and
                NNNN is a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at
                creation, equal to one more than the number of owners that
                existed at that time.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners that live in the same
                household. Assigned when an owner is created with
                'sharesHousehold' set to true and another owner already has the
                same last name and address; both owners then carry the same
                value. Absent for owners that do not belong to a shared
                household.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formed at read time
                as normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' +
                (householdId or empty). Two owners are duplicates only when their
                whole identityKey is equal; a create whose identityKey matches an
                existing owner's is rejected with 409.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed at the time this owner
                was created sharing the same first name and last name, compared
                case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
                Assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Flag captured at creation time: true when more than 80 owners
                had already been created for the same day at the time this owner
                was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-

              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:

              description: >-

              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:

          required:
